rule.statement: To prove prescriptive title, the burden of proof rests on the party to establish a starting point for their acquisition of prescriptive rights.
rule.supporting_quote: where a party invokes the provisions of Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance in order to defeat the ownership of an adverse claimant to immovable property, the burden of proof rests squirely and fairly on him to establish a starting point for his or her acquisition of prescriptive rights
